# PowerLawScaling

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The statistical property of avalanche sizes and inter-event intervals following a power-law distribution, a hallmark signature of self-organized criticality in neuromorphic systems. Serves as a measurable indicator for validating criticality in hardware implementations, bridging theoretical models with practical TCC/iNEST devices.
